title: Live files W: web edit mode, conflict banner, source indicators and watch ping
description:
Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md (revision 2) sections 5.2 (shapes), 6.3 (errors), 10 (the whole of it), 11.5, 11.6, 15 (W). Read docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md before touching a background, region or border. Gherkin first (features/computer_file_live.feature, tag @web); pure logic in vitest.

Owns these scenarios: every @web scenario (LF-40 to LF-45 and LF-63).

Files (web/):
- lib/computer-files.ts: source "snapshot" | "live"; stale, fallback_reason, retry_after_ms; content gains revealed, editable, modified_at; entries gain modified_at; error wording for computer_not_live, owner_warming, owner_timeout, outcome_unknown, precondition_failed, already_exists, file_too_large, content_too_large, rate_limited, path_refused; source line texts of 10.1.
- lib/computer-files-api.ts: writeComputerFile (PUT, If-Match / If-None-Match), revealComputerFile, watchComputerFiles (open true/false, keepalive on close), statComputerFile.
- lib/computer-files-edit.ts (new): the pure editor state machine of 10.4 (viewing, editing, saving, saved, conflict, warning), dirty tracking, Pi-changed detection from a tool-card change within 60 s or a stat probe difference (size, modified_at).
- lib/touched-files.ts: TouchedFile gains lastCallId so a second write to the same path counts as a change.
- components/workspace/ComputerFilesPanel.tsx and ComputerFilesView.tsx: source line replacing SavedCopyNote, watch ping every 15 s while the tab is visible and one close ping on hide/unmount, automatic retry after retry_after_ms (three times), Edit button only when editable, text area, Save, New file, discard prompt, conflict banner (Overwrite with mine, Use theirs, Copy mine), Pi-changed notice, Reveal with confirmation and Hide, 5 s stat probe while editing, 44 px targets, aria-live source line, role="alert" banner, phone layout stacked.
- lib/computer-files-fixtures.ts and the vitest files beside each module (computer-files*.test.ts, touched-files.test.ts, computer-files-edit.test.ts).
- features-support/web-harness-runner.ts and a steps file (steps/web-computer-files.steps.ts) so the @web scenarios run against a fake running computer; this harness has no file-panel steps today.

Acceptance: cd web && npm test green; cd conversation && npm run test:features green with the @web scenarios in features/cucumber-features.txt; manual pass at 375 px width; nothing is stored in localStorage or the URL; a revealed secret is cleared on Hide, navigation, tab switch and unmount.

Dependencies: F0 for the shapes (the web app mirrors them in its own types; it does not import host-protocol). Develops against fixtures; integrates after A2 is deployed. Absent `editable` means no editor, so it is safe to merge before A2.

Rules: no emojis, no line comments. Do not read or write project/.

REVISION 2 (edit while the computer is off):
- The editor is offered on a snapshot answer when the response says editable (source snapshot, computer off). A 200 with source "overlay" shows "Saved. Your change will be applied when the computer starts" and no "not yet in the saved copy" line; a 200 with source "live" shows "Saved on the computer" and the line "Not yet in the saved copy" (backed_up false).
- Listing rows and the open file with overlay "pending" show "Edited, waiting for the computer".
- overlay "conflict": the banner "Your edit conflicts with a newer version of this file" with theirs (the response) beside mine (GET content?variant=mine); buttons Overwrite with mine (PUT with If-Match of theirs), Use theirs (POST /computer/files/overlay/discard after the discard prompt), Copy mine.
- Errors keep the draft: computer_starting and computer_stopping retried automatically after retry_after_ms (three times, then Retry), owner_too_old, overlay_full, not_in_saved_copy, edit_unsupported (wording in section 10.4).
- Viewing or editing never starts a computer and the watch ping on a computer that is off answers state "off".
- New fixtures and vitest for the overlay states.


REVISION 3 (owner decision O5: delete, rename and new folders are required in Phase 3, also while the computer is off; contract sections 3 L48 to L66, 5.2, 5.5, 7.8, 8.1):
- Controls: Delete (with confirmation), Rename, New folder for any member; the recursive delete of a non-empty folder only for the organization owner role, behind a confirmation that names the folder and the file count ('Delete old and the 3 files in it?'). A directory's tree hash comes from stat (ETag) and is the If-Match of delete and rename.
- Pending change marks: 'Renamed, waiting for the computer', 'New, waiting for the computer'; deleted entries disappear from the listing; a 'Pending changes' list (GET /computer/files/overlay) with a Discard per entry (POST /computer/files/overlay/discard {path, revision}).
- Wording for path_busy, directory_not_empty, owner_role_required, invalid_move, too_many_entries, already_exists on rename.
- Scenarios: LF-75 (five @web scenarios).
